skills.skill_desc:
Valentina gains 8-50 extra EXP (scales with level) each time she deals damage to an enemy hero. Cooldown: 2s.
If the enemy hero's level is not higher than hers, 30% of the damage dealt is converted into her HP.

Valentina casts <font color="a6aafb">Shadow Strike</font> in the target direction, dealing 475<font color="62f8fe"> (+145% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies hit and slowing them by 40% for 1s.
Enemy heroes hit are marked with a <font color="a6aafb">Shadow Sigil</font> for 4s. Marked enemies hit by <font color="a6aafb">Shadow Strike</font> again are <font color="a6aafb">Terrified</font> for 1s (a target can only be terrified once every 4s).

Valentina dashes in the target direction, firing 3 Shadow Bolts at nearby enemies that deal 90<font color="62f8fe"> (+30% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> each. She can cast this skill again within 6s (costs Mana).

Each time a Shadow Bolt hits an enemy, the cooldown of <font color="a6aafb">Shadow Strike</font> is reduced by 1s.

Valentina slows the target enemy hero by 70% for 0.5s and gains the ability to cast their <font color="a6aafb">Ultimate</font>. Casting the enemy's <font color="a6aafb">Ultimate</font> turns her into the enemy hero's form and inherits their Basic Attack type for up to 12s (her regular skills remain unchanged unless the enemy's <font color="a6aafb">Ultimate</font> has a <font color="a6aafb">Morph</font> effect).
The stolen <font color="a6aafb">Ultimate</font>'s level equals Valentina's own <font color="a6aafb">Ultimate</font> level, and its cooldown is 120% of the target's (but no lower than 10s).
If the target is a Physical Damage hero, Valentina gains <font color="62f8fe"> (+100% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="fba51f"><1020></font> for the duration. This cannot be used on an enemy Valentina.
